    gsl.gsl_linalg_LU_decomp.restype = ctypes.c_int

    gsl.gsl_matrix_alloc.restype = ctypes.c_void_p

    n = len(matrix)

    matrix_ptr = gsl.gsl_matrix_alloc(n, n)
    data_ptr = ctypes.cast(matrix_ptr, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double))
    for i in range(n * n):
        data_ptr[i] = data[i]
    p = gsl.gsl_permutation_alloc(n)

    return (lu_matrix, permutation, signum.value)

    data = np.array([item for row in matrix for item in row], dtype=np.float64)

    mat.owner = 1
    return mat

    ctypes.memmove(data.ctypes.data, mat.data, m * n * ctypes.sizeof(ctypes.c_double))

    ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
    gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

    class gsl_function(ctypes.Structure):
        _fields_ = [
            ("function", ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_void_p)),
            ("params", ctypes.c_void_p),
        ]

    class gsl_cheb_series(ctypes.Structure):
        _fields_ = [
            ("n", ctypes.c_size_t),
            ("coeff", ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)),
            ("a", ctypes.c_double),
            ("b", ctypes.c_double),
        ]

    def func_wrapper(x, params):
        return func(x)

    c_func = ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_void_p)(func_wrapper)

    gsl_func = gsl_function()
    gsl_func.function = c_func
    gsl_func.params = ctypes.c_void_p(0)

    gsl.chebyshev_coefficients.argtypes = [ctypes.c_int, ctypes.POINTER(gsl_function), ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
    gsl.chebyshev_coefficients.restype = ctypes.POINTER(gsl_cheb_series)

    cs = gsl.chebyshev_coefficients(order, ctypes.byref(gsl_func), a, b)

    n = cs.contents.n
    coeff_ptr = cs.contents.coeff
    coefficients = [coeff_ptr[i] for i in range(n + 1)]

    return coefficients
